name: Zenbook Duo bottom OLED
author: squinto
description: UX8406CA (not UX8406MA) bottom OLED (eDP-2) stays off by default. A bar button turns it on. Does not use folio/keyboard attach as a hide path.

barWidget.description: Toggle the Zenbook Duo bottom OLED (eDP-2). Default off. Enable with --after omarchy.tray to sit in the right cluster after the system tray.
